fields.label: Hide Currency Symbol
fields.description: Do not show any symbol like $ etc next to currencies.

fields.label: Disable Rounded Total
fields.description: If disable, 'Rounded Total' field will not be visible in any transaction

fields.label: Disable In Words
fields.description: If disable, 'In Words' field will not be visible in any transaction

fields.label: Use Posting Date for Naming Documents
fields.description: When checked, the system will use the posting date of the document for naming instead of the creation date.

fields.label: Enable Item Search Index
fields.description: Speeds up Item search on large catalogues. Requires a single app server: the index is a file on that server's disk, and several servers would each answer from a different copy. Building it takes about 20 minutes for 3 million items, and runs in the background.
